title: Further Embeds Chainlink ACE in ADGM Compliance Platform
why_it_matters: The integration moves jurisdiction-specific compliance checks into transaction execution, giving tokenized-asset operators a programmable control layer while leaving regulatory authorization and legal accountability unchanged.
caption:
RWA WIRE // COMPLIANCE INFRASTRUCTURE

Further Embeds Chainlink ACE in ADGM Compliance Platform

Further Asset Management has integrated Chainlink ACE into Anubis to apply configured compliance policies to tokenized-asset transactions, initially for ADGM-related workflows.
